title: Terminology Tests History
description: The change history for the terminology tests is maintained on the [test history](test-history.html) page in this IG. The entries below are the historical ones from before that page existed; this file is retained because the TxTester reads the current version from it.

versions.markdown: See the [test history](test-history.html) page. The TxTester reports the first version in this list as the version of the tests it ran, so this entry has to be the release being prepared.

The change history has moved to the [test history](test-history.html) page in this IG, which is maintained from 1.9.2 onwards. This file is only still here because the TxTester reads the version from it.

* Add a set of tests for controlling the version of CodeSystems (ValueSet.compose.include.version, with wildcards, and the expansion parmaeters system-version etc
* revisit the tests to ensure that
* Remove the deprecated 'version' parameter that's no longer used or supported (after 1 year of grace)
* Various improvements to error messages and test descriptions

Allow expansion.id & expansion.offset in many tests. Rename valueset-version to default-valueset-version. tx.fhir.org only: Add supplement test cases and LOINC tests for tx.fhir.org for CLASSTYPE, answers-for, and answer-list
Add test for validation of displayLanguage
remove language weights except where it matters, add x-caused-by-unknown-system when supplement not found, and Remove R4 variants
Move master tests to tx-ecosystem-ig instead of general test cases
* Fix references to wrong value set in supplement tests

* Add specific tests for the interaction between ValueSet.compose.inactive and the activeOnly parameter
* Add tests for correctly populated CapabilityStatement and TerminologyCapabilities resources
There is no specific history for the terminology test cases prior to version 1.60. The only history notes available are mixed in with all the other kinds of tests in the github release notes.
